symptom: Last-minute deep links constrain the business flow to one incoming room, the calendar does not show minimum-stay price context, the permanent last-minute page hides the full collection in a rail, and geography administration exposes only aggregate coordinate counts.
expected_behavior: All property units are evaluated, calendar rules and truthful prices are visible, every verified deal is listed, and every missing-coordinate town is actionable.
environment: Candidate commit 48fed79619328590e0404edef27e4af6793c7a92 before production publication; production remains VII v657.

steps: Open the supplied Raphael Bekerem deep link
reproduction.evidence: User screenshots and direct source inspection on 2026-10-25.

observations.observation: client-page passes the incoming roomID into useViiStayQuote.
CalendarDemo receives live availability but only fictional listings receive a priceResolver.
The permanent page renders HomeLiveDeals in the same horizontal track used by the homepage.
The geography UI calculates the 1245/1221 metrics from city nodes and has no missing-coordinate filter.

hypotheses.mechanism: Shared components were reused without a destination-specific mode and the incoming roomID was treated as a hard query constraint.
hypotheses.prediction: The source will show a shared rail on /last-minute and pass preferredSupplierRoomID to the live quote.
hypotheses.discriminating_test: Inspect the actual props and request body.

hypotheses.mechanism: The supplier APIs do not expose rules, prices or complete entities.
hypotheses.prediction: Official documentation would omit minNights, date totals, all room calendars and geography identities.
hypotheses.discriminating_test: Read the official supplier calendar, search and geography contracts.
hypotheses.result: The calendar exposes every room and minNights; search window exposes verified date totals; geography exposes every city identity. Only calendar-native per-day price is absent.

hypotheses.mechanism: The geography metrics represent businesses and the API omitted 24 business map points.
hypotheses.prediction: The count would be calculated from business catalog rows.
hypotheses.discriminating_test: Inspect the count source and data type.
hypotheses.result: Both numbers are calculated from city nodes, so the missing entities are towns, not businesses.

fix.change: Added destination-specific complete-list and missing-point modes, removed the incoming room hard constraint from property-wide availability, and enriched calendar days from the documented search window without inventing values.
fix.evidence: 24/24 focused pre-Professor tests, production build, localization completeness, and 1649/1649 full regression tests passed on the candidate.

localization-completeness passed 3 of 3 tests after adding the five new UI phrases.
The full test family passed 1649 of 1649 tests.
